title: Tell me about yourself
text: Can you walk me through your background, your main technical interests, and what brings you to this role?
model_answer: I have been focusing on full-stack software development with Python and Flutter, building scalable backend services and responsive client interfaces. I thrive when solving complex architectural problems and delivering clean, well-tested code.
tips: Use the Present, Past, Future structure: what you do now, past relevant projects, and why this role matches your career trajectory.

title: Greatest Strength
text: What would you say is your greatest technical or professional strength?
model_answer: My greatest strength is my systematic problem-solving mindset. When faced with an unfamiliar bug or legacy codebase, I isolate root causes with reproducible benchmarks rather than guessing.
tips: Back your claim with a concrete, concise technical story.
